brief: From the guard, step back out of the range of the person in front: rear foot back then front foot back, about 30 cm each, keeping the guard and the balance; head at least 70 cm from his head (surface to surface) by 1.2 s.
notes: Fighter 2 stands still facing the hero; at the start the heads are 48 cm apart (surface to surface). A step is a card's 'steps' entry (each foot's floor displacement on that card) with the hips moved by the card's offset. 30 fps.

asserts.line: fighter 1 head at least 70 cm from fighter 2 head at 1.2 s +-3 f
